title: HONEYJOON — Indie Meme Screening + Filmmaker Q&A
description:
Mother. Daughter. Grief. The Azores. And enough unsolicited advice to make any South Asian daughter feel seen. 

Join Indie Meme for HONEYJOON, a funny, tender mother-daughter story about family, loss, identity, and loving someone even when they drive you a little crazy.

Filmmaker Lilian T. Mehrel
